headline_marked: [[Lionel Messi makes first public appearance]] in Rosario since World Cup final defeat
headline: Lionel Messi makes first public appearance in Rosario since World Cup final defeat
summary: Football icon Lionel Messi was seen attending a Primera C league match involving his family's club, Leones FC, near his hometown of Rosario, marking his first public outing since Argentina's World Cup final loss.
details: Lionel Messi made his first public appearance since Argentina's heartbreaking defeat in the FIFA World Cup final. The football icon attended a Primera C league match between Leones FC, a club run by his family, and Central Córdoba.

The match took place on Saturday at the Antonio Di Giacomo Stadium in Arroyo Seco, near his hometown of Rosario. Messi, who is spending time with his family, arrived after kickoff wearing a black hoodie to maintain a low profile.
Despite his efforts, the eight-time Ballon d'Or winner was quickly recognised by supporters and television cameras. He was captured watching the match from a balcony behind one of the goals.
Children and fans chanted his name, drawing warm applause from those in attendance. Messi acknowledged the crowd with a smile and a wave.

However, Leones FC suffered a 2-0 defeat to Central Córdoba, with Marcos Córdoba and Franco Fernandez scoring the goals. This loss leaves Leones fourth in Zone B, seven points behind league leaders Canuelas.
Messi had returned directly to Rosario after Argentina finished as runners-up, choosing to spend his break with family instead of joining the main squad's hero's welcome in Buenos Aires.

His return to club football with Inter Miami remains uncertain, as head coach Guillermo Hoyos recently stated there is "no return date" for the veteran forward. This brief appearance offered local fans a rare opportunity to see Messi back home.

headline: Bangladeshi youths lured to Russia for jobs, end up in Ukrainian prison after joining war
summary: Two Bangladeshi youths, seeking better opportunities, were reportedly deceived by brokers into participating in the Russia-Ukraine conflict, leading to their capture.
details: Two Bangladeshi youths traveled to Russia hoping for a better life and job prospects. They were reportedly ensnared by brokers who coerced them into joining the ongoing Russia-Ukraine conflict.

The youths' journey for economic betterment took a drastic turn, leading them from the promise of employment to the front lines of a foreign war. Their current situation sees them detained in a Ukrainian prison.
